## Type

- [ ] Wording or structure only — no change to what a score means

## Checklist

- [ ] Paper only. No tooling, scorers, or fixtures.
- [ ] Vendor-neutral. Reads the same whoever ships the product.
- [ ] Stays inside static / at-rest scope, or explicitly revises Scope and Non-Goals.
- [ ] No acquisition or exploitation walkthroughs.
- [ ] No third-party app teardowns, extracted keys, or recovered source.
- [ ] Claims about prior art, methods, or OWASP mappings cite a source.
- [ ] American English, active voice, scannable sections.
